name: OHCHR Universal Human Rights Index (UHRI)

_api.notes: OHCHR offers free public REST API access to the Universal Human Rights Index. Confirmed working public export endpoint returns the full dataset as JSON (>10 MB) and XLSX. Full filtered-query endpoint parameters are provided on request to uhrisupport@ohchr.org; the export endpoints are directly usable without contact.

download.notes: Individual recommendations/observations resolve to /en/document/{uuid} human-readable pages. Bulk data (all recommendations from Treaty Bodies, Special Procedures and the UPR) is available directly via the JSON/XLSX export endpoints.

enrich.notes: The JSON export provides structured records (country-specific observations and recommendations) per document/UUID, enabling record-level enrichment without HTML scraping. Updated daily.

methodologyMarkdown:
## Overview
The OHCHR Universal Human Rights Index (https://uhri.ohchr.org/en/search) is a JavaScript SPA front-end, but it is backed by a REAL public REST API. OHCHR advertises 'free public access ... through a REST API with various filtering possibilities' on its /en/our-data-api page and exposes bulk export endpoints.

## Search
The SPA search UI is JS-rendered (a plain GET of the search route returns no document content), so scraping the HTML is not viable. Instead use the backend REST API under /api/uhri/. Confirmed public export endpoints: /api/uhri/export-results/export-full-en.json (full dataset, JSON) and .../export-full-en.xlsx. Detailed filtered-query endpoint parameters are obtainable from uhrisupport@ohchr.org.

## Filters
The API is documented as supporting 'various filtering possibilities' (country, body/mechanism - Treaty Bodies, Special Procedures, UPR - subject/theme). Exact query parameters are provided by OHCHR on request; not enumerated here because they were not publicly documented on the page.

## Download
Bulk: direct JSON/XLSX export (verified - the JSON endpoint returned a payload exceeding 10 MB, i.e. real data). Per-document: human-readable pages at /en/document/{uuid}.

## Metadata & Enrichment
Rich structured records (country, mechanism, recommendation text, references) come straight from the JSON export, enabling dspace-item-style record enrichment without HTML parsing. Data is refreshed daily.

## Limitations
The interactive search UI is JS-only and would need a headless browser; however the REST/export API makes that unnecessary for ingestion. The fully-documented filtered endpoints require a support-email request, so programmatic fine-grained filtering may need that documentation first.
probeNotes: WebFetch of the /en/search route returned a 404/SPA shell (JS-rendered, no doc links). WebSearch + WebFetch of https://uhri.ohchr.org/en/our-data-api confirmed a public REST API with export endpoints /api/uhri/export-results/export-full-en.json and .xlsx. Fetching the JSON endpoint returned data exceeding the 10 MB fetch limit, confirming it serves the real full dataset. Set family=rest-api.
